title: East Tyrol Biathlon Center Obertilliach
name: East Tyrol Biathlon Center Obertilliach
kurzbeschreibung: The Biathlonzentrum Osttirol in Obertilliach at 1,400 m: World Cup training venue with 30 small-bore shooting lanes, roller ski track, and guest biathlon.
beschreibung:
Overview

The state-of-the-art Langlauf- und Biathlonzentrum Osttirol is located on the eastern outskirts of the heritage-protected village of Obertilliach in the East Tyrolean Lesachtal (Bezirk Lienz) at a snow-reliable altitude of around 1,400 metres above sea level. Nestled in the wide valley basin between the Karnische Alpen and the Gailtaler Alpen, this sports venue built to strict IBU standards is considered one of the most traditional and sought-after training hubs for World Cup athletes and national teams from around the globe. Alongside international elite sport, the facility offers holidaymakers and recreational athletes thrilling insights into the world of biathlon.

Roller Ski Track & Guest Biathlon

The core of the complex is the modern shooting range featuring 30 fully electronic small-bore shooting lanes and an integrated penalty loop. During the snow-free summer months, professionals and amateur athletes train on an approximately five-kilometre paved and floodlit roller ski track that winds gracefully through the valley with varied elevation profiles and curves. A standout attraction for visitors is the popular Gästebiathlon (guest biathlon): under the guidance of state-certified coaches, beginners and sports enthusiasts discover the art of combining physical endurance with pinpoint shooting using genuine biathlon rifles. In winter, the centre serves as a gateway to the famous Grenzlandloipe cross-country trail, spanning over 60 kilometres.

Visit & Getting There

The Biathlonzentrum Osttirol is open year-round; the roller ski track and shooting range can be used during operating hours from Monday to Saturday (roller ski track day fee approx. €7.00). Guest biathlon workshops and taster courses take place weekly on fixed dates (costs approx. €35.00 per person including ammunition and instruction; advance registration required). Getting there by car: Via the B100 to Tassenbach, continuing on the B111 to Obertilliach; the centre is well signposted in the Rals district (large free car park). By public transport: Train to Sillian or Tassenbach station, followed by the valley bus (Tälerbus) to Obertilliach.

Tips

Inside the main building of the biathlon centre, a welcoming café-bistro with a panoramic sun terrace invites guests to relax while watching the athletes' shooting practice up close. The entire facility is fully accessible.
